validation_boundaries: These are consistency and arithmetic checks, not authenticated transaction verification or investment outcomes. Full stress replays are not claimed for the new Eve price.
preservation_method: Compare candidate recursive Git tree with the baseline; require no removal and no change outside this new packet, README.md, CURRENT_WORKFLOW.md and AGENTS.md before publishing. Existing master, SOP, financial model/inputs, map and investigation app must retain their Git blob IDs.
reproduction: node reproduce.cjs uses gh authentication and pinned remote input files; no new local repository or output file required.
publication: Expected-head main update only. No branch, force push, local filesystem output or third-party contact.
